turns.assessment: The fault localizes to the first fibre span on the S15→S04 OMS. The booster output at S15 stayed normal, while the input and output powers of every downstream amplifier fell by about 14 dB and span0 raised OSC_LOS at the same onset. This is the signature of a large persistent loss added between amp0 and amp1, not an amplifier failure; the residual power and unaffected reverse direction make a complete fibre cut less likely.

proposals.rationale: E14 is immediately after the unchanged booster and before all three amplifiers showing the same approximately 14 dB power reduction. Large added span loss also explains OSC_LOS, downstream OMS_LOS, widespread OSNR/BER collapse, and the affected services.

A cut on this span would explain OSC loss and the broad outage, but measurable downstream power remained at roughly 14 dB below baseline and the opposite direction showed no change, favoring severe added loss over a complete cable cut.
